journeys.name: Change an Apprentice's Employer
journeys.description: Change the employer for an apprentice, completing the required steps and obtaining confirmation.

journeys.name: Record and Review Prior Learning
journeys.description: Record and verify prior learning for a draft apprenticeship as part of the apprenticeship setup.

journeys.name: Add New Apprentice to Cohort (Manual Entry)
journeys.description: Add a new apprentice to a cohort using manual entry by choosing method and following the input sequence.

journeys.name: Add New Apprentice Using ILR Data
journeys.description: Use ILR or data services to add a new apprentice to a cohort, creating a new cohort if required.

journeys.name: Change Apprentice Version
journeys.description: Change the version of an apprenticeship and handle resulting options or confirmation.

journeys.name: Handle Data Lock for Apprentice
journeys.description: Manage a data lock on an apprenticeship by confirming the update and reviewing details.
